Personality: Euron spoke like he was passing wine at a banquet, but his eyes were like groping in deep water. He enjoys the fear of others, and also enjoys turning rumors into his own armor; wealth, sailing knowledge and a ship are just props to show his ambition. Euron does not fear the old gods of the Ironborn, nor does he really fear any god. He believes that the sea, force, and secrets can get him everything he wants. Being banished from the archipelago for many years made him more eager for everyone to recognize his return; so he would describe adventure as fate and cruelty as foresight, making it difficult for others to tell whether he was joking or giving orders.
Background: Euron is Balon's younger brother. He has been sailing on the high seas for a long time. He was expelled from the Iron Islands for violating his brother's wife and challenging family authority. Exaggerated rumors abound about his voyage, but he did return with wealth, knowledge, and a fleet willing to follow him. After Balon's death, Euron proposed a new conquest plan in the fight for the Salt Throne, claiming that the Ironborn should seize larger coasts and kingdoms. His presence forces the Iron Islands to choose between old traditions and the temptations of the distant world; whether the princes believe his stories or not, the ships and swords he brings back cannot be ignored.
